title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with a source-bound XDATA layer name

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE, APPID and existing LAYER 0 records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

authority.relevant_rule: XDATA code 1003 carries the name of the layer associated with the extended data.

proof.source: The runtime-generated source contains the exact 1001/1003/1000 sequence. Original LTYPE capture records the code-1003 LayerName role at the matching physical group. Provider resolution binds the unique source LAYER record, complete raw/typed source proof, and captured origin to the decoded layer name.
proof.output: For all four ASCII/binary source/output combinations, physical XDATA order and values are checked and a fresh import verifies typed fields. Output inspection binds exactly one emitted LAYER row by source-remapped handle, exact name, and LAYER table owner; live source model changes invalidate the binding.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the referenced LAYER 0 from the live model refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring the provider succeeds on the same adapter.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 layer name (`0`) in one code-1003 position under one APPID. It does not qualify other layer names, repeated/multiple layer references, or other source versions and LTYPE schemas.
Code-1005 object-handle XDATA dependencies, coordinate tuples, APPID metadata, other XDATA compositions and broader dependency closure remain unqualified.

This receipt establishes transport and the selected LAYER dependency binding only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, native CAD semantics, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
